texts.value: Cell adhesion molecule that functions as a receptor ligand of the signaling receptor ITGAL:ITGB2/LFA-1 (lymphocyte-function associated (LFA) molecule 1) ensuring leukocyte cell-cell adhesion on resting cells (PubMed:10077629, PubMed:1676048, PubMed:2497351). Also endothelial blood vessels receptor ligand of dendritic cell (DC) CD209 signaling receptor that mediates triggering transendothelial migration of DC presursors from blood into peripheral tissues and, subsequently, into lymphoid tissues (PubMed:11017109). Mediates adhesive interactions important for antigen presentation, lymphocyte recirculation, and other cellular interactions important for immune response and surveillance (Probable)
Interacts with RDX, EZR and MSN
Co-localizes with RDX, EZR and MSN in microvilli

Constitutively expressed on leukocytes and endothelium (PubMed:1676048). Expressed on resting lymphocytes and monocytes, but not in neutrophils (PubMed:1676048). Abundantly expressed on endothelial vascular cells as well as lymphatic vessels in tonsils (PubMed:11017109)
Belongs to the immunoglobulin superfamily. ICAM family

features.description: Required for interaction with EZR, MSN and RDX and co-localization to microvilli
